comments.zh: 1. Fluent side new instance: Before -> assign -> After phases + derived fields + mapped properties kept as-is
comments.en: 1. Fluent-side new mapping: Before → assignment → After phases + derived fields + original mapping properties preserved

comments.zh: 2. Fluent side _Update: Before sees dst old value (update preserves existing values)
comments.en: 2. Fluent-side _Update: Before observes old dst values (preserves existing values during update)

comments.zh: 3. Attribute side: class-level [BeforeMapping]/[AfterMapping] (two-parameter host form) -- output isomorphic to the Fluent side
comments.en: 3. Attribute-side: class-level [BeforeMapping]/[AfterMapping] (dual-parameter host form) — produces structurally identical output as Fluent-side

comments.zh: 4. Cross-pair signature filtering (D-d): pairs with mismatched signatures emit no hooks and raise no diagnostics
comments.en: 4. Cross-pair signature filtering (D-d): pairs with mismatched signatures are neither invoked nor reported in diagnostics
